changelog: 12S / CytB fish eDNA. (1) CytB: preset 'CytB fish (L14912 / H15149)' on the 12S / CytB pipeline (12S licence), MIDORI2 CytB trainset. (2) Species names by BLASTn (12S/CytB, on by default for new 12S runs; DADA2 kept beside): reference built from the newest MIDORI2 (GenBank, Leray et al. 2022) + newest MitoFish (Zhu et al. 2023), with records MitoFish judges mislabelled (heterospecific) and records with >1% ambiguous bases removed; limited to fish (NCBI: txid 7898 ray-finned + txid 7777 cartilaginous) or vertebrates (txid 7742); a sequence filed under several species is kept once and named to their shared rank; up to 5000 hits per ASV so ties are never cut off; lowest common rank of ties within 0.5%, never a species below 98.5% (genus 95, family 90, order 85, class 80); human and other non-target ASVs keep their real names; every ASV checked against NCBI nt (BLAST URL API), disagreements and NCBI species ties cut to the shared rank and flagged; a failed NCBI batch keeps the finished ones (its ASVs: not checked). Install: bash download_databases.sh --fishmito. (3) Customer report (Job Detail → Build report → Customer report): the lab's per-sample format, same headings and figure placement, cover left blank for the BI team, no company name; Word + PDF + SampleN_ folders (Box plot, bar charts per rank, Top 50 heatmap, Krona, rarefaction, alpha, outfiles, BIOM, Excel per sample) as one zip; FastQC, fastp, cutadapt, DADA2, BLASTn, phyloseq, ggplot2, microbiomeutilities, Krona, vegan. Install: bash setup_amplicon_report.sh. The report states only what the run did (pool, rm.phix, fastp as a check, BLAST skipped, unknown raw counts, samples the pipeline dropped). Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: setup_shotgun.sh --func: the conda env ngamp-func was created with python 3.10, but bioconda builds humann 3.9 for python 3.12 only, so 'humann_databases' stopped with "No module named 'humann'". The env now uses python 3.12, is checked by importing humann and metaphlan, and a broken env is rebuilt. Nothing else changes; no backend restart needed.
